_kv_cache_note: flash_attn/cache_type_k/cache_type_v are optional and apply to start, -dual and -big alike; omit them entirely and the command line is exactly what it was before these keys existed. A quantised KV cache roughly halves what context costs in VRAM (~64MiB -> ~32MiB per 1K tokens on a 27B), which is what keeps a ~25GB Q6 27B plus a real context inside one 32GB R9700 instead of forcing a cross-GPU -big split. flash_attn is required for cache_type_v and is assumed 'on' when you set it; use true instead of "on" if your llama.cpp build is old enough that --flash-attn takes no argument. Override per-backend by putting the same keys inside the vulkan_split block. See docs/quantization.md.
_context_note: default_context is the ceiling that fits ONE card. A 27B's KV cache costs ~64MiB per 1K tokens at f16 and half that at q8_0, so with a ~25GB Q6 and the q8_0 cache above, 131072 is about what a 32GB R9700 holds. -big spans both cards and can take the full 262144 — set vulkan_split.default_context for that, which overrides this value for -big only. See docs/quantization.md.
_speed_note: spec_type="draft-mtp" turns on speculative decoding using the multi-token-prediction heads Qwen already trained into Qwen3.8 — Unsloth's GGUFs carry them as blk.*.nextn.* tensors, so there is no draft model to download. Reported +33% to +120% depending on the card. Needs llama.cpp from PR #22673 (July 2026, b10335) or newer; older builds ignore the tensors silently, with or without the flag. Sweep spec_draft_n_max 2-4, and keep --parallel at 1 or the gain shrinks. batch_size/ubatch_size tune prompt processing rather than generation — raising ubatch_size from its 512 default trades compute-buffer VRAM for prefill speed, which is what you feel at a large window. See docs/quantization.md.
_yarn_note: Not set anywhere above, deliberately. rope_scaling/rope_scale/yarn_orig_ctx push the window past the model's native max (262144 for Qwen3.8-27B) — e.g. rope_scaling="yarn", rope_scale=4, yarn_orig_ctx=262144 for a 1048576 window. llama.cpp's YaRN is static: the scale applies to every request, so it costs quality on ordinary short prompts too. If you want it, put those three keys inside the vulkan_split block rather than at the top level, so only -big sessions pay for it and start/-dual stay on the native window. See docs/quantization.md.
_dual_gpu_and_vulkan_split_are_disabled_: The two blocks below are examples only, nested under this inert key so this file stays valid JSON without needing comments. To enable -dual and -big commands, copy the 'dual_gpu' and/or 'vulkan_split' objects out to the top level of your real ~/.llamesa/config.json (as siblings of 'gpus' above) and delete this wrapper key entirely. Never required for v1's start/stop/restart/status/logs or the existing --gpu 0|1|all commands. See docs/dual-gpu.md.
